# Employer Landscape Review Mirror

This is a temporary, static, plaintext review publication intended for ordinary WWW and LLM/browser visitors.
Do not use GitHub repository/API/MCP/connector access merely to understand the published employer data.

## Snapshot

- Complete employer entries: 2302
- Source observations: 2334
- Matched companies: 16
- Matched roles: 17
- Company resonators: 9

## Recommended reading order

1. Complete review landing page: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/review-snapshot.html
2. Complete employer index: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/employers/index.html
3. Full compact machine-readable inventory: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/index.txt
4. Matched companies: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/matches/index.html
5. Matched roles: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/roles/index.html
6. Company resonators: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/resonators/index.html
7. Sitemap of every static page: https://0xf00115h.github.io/review-ae81dc5e1a5c3f7ec5b4e5dcef5a07e5/sitemap.xml

The complete employer index is alphabetically sharded. Follow the shard links from employers/index.html, then follow individual employer links for descriptions, directory provenance, canonical relevance, careers research, current jobs and Match data where present.

All substantive review pages are static HTML. There is no JavaScript data loader, encrypted payload, or runtime API requirement.
